analyst_note: THE ARMED CATALYST PASSED WITHOUT ESCALATING. The 2026-08-06 unconditional lockup tranche — 911.5M shares, ~7% of outstanding, ~$105-116B, more than doubling free float from 4.9% to 11.8% — released, and the market absorbed it. SPCX closed $114.92, +6.14% on prior close $108.27, after printing a new all-time intraday low of $105.11 and reversing to close near the session high on ~2.0-2.1x average volume. Press attributes the absorption to low-cost-basis holders electing not to sell and to index/passive buying of freed shares. All three LIVE mechanisms HELD AT AMBER; flag stays WATCH; no state threshold crossed in either direction. This is a deliberate hold, not inertia: the runs RED marker was a turnover spike ON FALLING price and the session delivered a turnover spike on RISING price, so RED was not met — but the GREEN de-escalation clause requires modest REALIZED selling, and Form 4s lag up to two business days, so realized selling is simply unobservable today. Calling GREEN now would substitute one session of price action for the filing evidence the trigger asks for. Two things got structurally worse even on a good day: free float more than doubled (permanently larger run capacity, with further tranches staggered through the 2026-12-08 full expiry), and the Cursor consideration stays VWAP-based with the stock ~15% below the $135 offer into an expected Q3 close. Two observability gaps are load-bearing and both are actionable: margin/pledge trigger levels remain null (fire sales), and the IPO-pipeline node went UNVERIFIED today — no August read on the Anthropic or OpenAI listings was obtainable (interconnections). Classification drafted by Claude Code from public market data (sources: Yahoo Finance, stockanalysis.com, Investing.com, Bloomberg, TipRanks); reviewed and ENDORSED by H. Villarreal 2026-08-06.

runs.driving_observable: HELD AT AMBER — de-escalation candidate, not yet de-escalated. The armed catalyst fired and did NOT produce the RED marker: the compound test was a turnover spike ON FALLING price, and the session delivered a turnover spike on RISING price (2.0-2.1x average volume, close +6.14%). The 'break below the recent ~$108-111 lows on elevated volume' clause was touched intraday ($105.11, a new all-time low) but reversed within the session to close near the high — a supply test met by demand, which is the opposite of a run. Two reasons this is not yet GREEN. (1) The de-escalation clause requires 'modest REALIZED selling', and realized selling is unobservable today: Form 4s lag up to two business days, so no insider-disposition data exists yet for 08-06. Absent that, a GREEN call would rest on price action alone. (2) The structural run capacity rose sharply — free float went 4.9% -> 11.8% of shares outstanding — and only the first 20% tranche is out, with further staggered tranches through the 2026-12-08 full expiry. The mechanism is better-capitalized against a run than yesterday in sentiment terms and materially worse in structural terms.
